title: Puddle Planet Post Office Paper Tab Story Inference Card
inferenceSkill: Practice fictional inference by naming a clue, what it might suggest, why, a second clue, an inference sentence, and a paper tab check: ____________________.
useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only inference card for a pretend Puddle Planet Post Office story: ____________________.
adultSetup: Adult: set out one blank page, pencil, and two small paper tabs beside the puddle planet card: ____________________.
kidDirection: Writer: invent a puddle stamp desk, a planet pouch, and a helper who figures out what a small clue might suggest: ____________________.
cluePrompt: clue: write one made-up puddle stamp, desk mark, or pouch detail that the helper notices first: ____________________.
suggestsPrompt: might suggest: write what that first clue might suggest inside the pretend post office story: ____________________.
whyPrompt: why: write why the clue might suggest that idea instead of a different made-up idea: ____________________.
secondCluePrompt: second clue: write one different puddle planet detail that points toward the same inference: ____________________.
inferenceSentencePrompt: inference sentence: write one sentence that uses the clue, what it might suggest, why, and the second clue: ____________________.
paperTabCheckPrompt: paper tab check: mark the paper tab when the inference sentence stays invented, calm, and clear: ____________________.
quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill only the clue and might suggest blanks first, then pause: ____________________.
takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep this paper card and add one new puddle planet clue later with an adult: ____________________.
